const all = $input.all();

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are an expert Hebrew affiliate marketing copywriter AND product analyst.

You work in TWO phases for each product:

PHASE 1 — PRODUCT REVIEW (internal analysis):
Analyze the product carefully before writing anything. Consider:
- What is this product REALLY used for? Classify correctly (home decor, kitchen, bathroom, lighting, storage, gadget, garden, etc.)
- Who is the genuine target audience? (families, young adults, homeowners, renters, gift buyers, students)
- What real problem does it solve or what specific upgrade does it provide?
- Are the listed benefits accurate and relevant to THIS specific product? Discard generic ones.
- Is the current price genuinely attractive for an Israeli buyer?
- Is the previous price realistic or inflated?
- What would make someone in an Israeli Facebook/Telegram group actually stop scrolling and click?
- Any red flags? (misleading title, irrelevant benefits, overpriced)

PHASE 2 — AD WRITING:
Based ONLY on what you identified in Phase 1, write ONE polished Hebrew ad.

Ad rules:
1. Natural, friendly Hebrew — sounds like a trusted group admin recommending personally
2. Strong result-focused headline (never the product name)
   Good: "המטבח נראה סדור בלי שום מאמץ" / "תאורה שמשנה את כל החדר" / "פתרון אחסון שצריכים בכל בית"
3. Paragraph and benefits based ONLY on review findings — specific, not generic
4. Each benefit must be real and specific to THIS product
5. Discount > 70%: write "מחיר נמוך מאוד כרגע" carefully. Never claim official clearance.
6. Previous price unreliable: show only current price + discount %
7. No clickbait unless genuinely fits. Trust always beats hype.
8. Never misclassify. Never invent features.
9. One ad. Clean structure. Not too long.

OUTPUT FORMAT (use exactly these XML tags):
<REVIEW>
[Your thorough product analysis — category, audience, real benefits, price assessment, what makes it worth buying]
</REVIEW>
<AD>
[Headline with relevant emoji]

[קטע פתיח קצר: מה המוצר ולמי הוא מתאים]

✨ [יתרון אמיתי 1]
✨ [יתרון אמיתי 2]
✨ [יתרון אמיתי 3]
✨ [יתרון אמיתי 4]
✨ [יתרון אמיתי 5]

[משפט שיווקי קצר: השדרוג או הבעיה שנפתרת]

💰 מחיר: $X
[במקום $Y — רק אם המחיר הקודם נראה אמיתי]
[🏷️ Z% הנחה — אם יש]
[⭐ דירוג X — אם יש דירוג]
[📦 X+ הזמנות — אם יש]

👇 להזמנה:
[link]
</AD>`;

return all.map(item => {
  const p = item.json;
  
  if (p.message_type === 'INFO' || p.message_type === 'ERROR') {
    return Object.assign({}, item, { json: Object.assign({}, p, { groq_request_body: null }) });
  }
  
  const lines = [
    'Product title:\n' + (p.title || p.cleaned_title || ''),
    'Price:\n$' + (p.price || ''),
    p.original_price ? 'Previous price:\n$' + p.original_price : '',
    p.discount ? 'Discount:\n' + p.discount + '%' : '',
    (p.rating && p.rating > 0) ? 'Rating:\n' + p.rating : '',
    (p.orders && p.orders > 0) ? 'Orders/buyers:\n' + p.orders : '',
    'Link:\n' + (p.short_url || p.affiliate_link || ''),
    (p.benefit_bullets && p.benefit_bullets.length) ? 'Additional context:\n' + p.benefit_bullets.join(', ') : ''
  ].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
  
  const requestBody = JSON.stringify({
    model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
    messages: [
      { role: 'system', content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
      { role: 'user', content: lines }
    ],
    max_tokens: 1000,
    temperature: 0.75
  });
  
  return { json: Object.assign({}, p, { groq_request_body: requestBody }) };
});

   - Kitchen / Bathroom / Storage / Organization
   - Lighting / LED
   - Fitness / Wellness

4. Skip: Fashion, Beauty, Skincare, Automotive, Toys, Baby/Kids, Jewelry.

5. For each campaign JOINED: report name, activityId, commission rate.
6. For each campaign SKIPPED: report name + reason.

Give me a full summary when done.`;

  '――――――――――――――――――――',

].join('\n');

return [{ json: {
